Passive.description: The pre-set, continuous baseline delivery rate of intravenous medication measured in mL/h.

Active.description: Instant mechanical safety alarm triggered upon detection of a blockage or fluid pathway obstruction.

Dynamic.description: Continuously aggregating metric representing the precise total volume of medication dispensed to the patient.

Location.description: Localized tracking attributes assigning the medical asset to a specific hospital floor, ward, and bed index.

Equipment.description: Globally unique hardware identifier hardcoded into the regulatory-compliant clinical asset.

Status.description: The active mode flag of the pumping core state machine (Infusing, Keep Vein Open, or Paused).

User.description: Authentication signature log of the verified clinical staff member programming or altering dosage limits.

Operational.description: Remaining internal battery capacity monitoring percentage used during mobile patient transport.

Service.description: System checks verifying that the programmed dose falls within safety boundaries defined by the hospital's central library.

RFID.description: RFID verification scan capturing the unique drug vial serialization payload to confirm patient mapping match.

Historical.description: Rolling historical audit log tracking exact medication timestamps and administered volumes over the preceding 24 hours.

Spectrum.description: Wireless link quality and RSSI measurements on the dedicated protected Wireless Medical Telemetry Service band.

Environmental.description: Clinical room relative humidity monitoring, cross-referenced against fluid sensor calibration tables.
